blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Current 4D occupancy world models use heavy cross-attention or deep recurrence to disentangle ego-motion from scene dynamics. This requires significant computational capacity. However, this effort is largely redundant since the ego-vehicle's intended future motion is provided by the downstream motion planner. We present FreeOcc, a lightweight continuous-time world model that introduces explicit $SE(2)$ geometric decoupling into a conditional flow-matching framework. By mathematically factoring out self-motion, we create a purely dynamic feature space. This space supports attention-free temporal fusion and allows physics-constrained ODEs to operate strictly on residual agent kinematics. To maximize deployment efficiency, FreeOcc introduces an uncertainty-aware blending mechanism. This routes well-observed voxels to a single-pass decoder, reserving the ODE solver exclusively for ambiguous, high-uncertainty regions. Requiring only 28.3M parameters-roughly 40% of comparable models-our optimal ensemble mode (FreeOcc-E) runs at 27 FPS. On nuScenes, FreeOcc achieves state-of-the-art forecasting performance with a 0.47 m Near Field Chamfer Distance (NFCD) and 32.1% mIoU. Furthermore, the model transfers zero-shot to SemanticKITTI. It also proves highly robust, retaining 92.8% of its ideal mIoU under significant sensor packet loss and timestamp jitter.
blocks.zh: 目前的4D占用世界模型使用沉重的交叉注意力或深层重现,将自我运动与场景动态分开. 这需要很大的计算能力。 然而,这一努力在很大程度上是多余的,因为自负车辆打算的未来运动是由下游运动计划员提供的. 我们提出FreeOcc,一种轻量级连续世界模型,将明确的$SE(2)美元几何脱钩引入有条件的流量匹配框架. 通过数学上考虑自我运动,我们创造了一个纯粹动态的特征空间. 这个空间支持无注意力的时间聚变,并允许物理约束的ODE严格在残余物剂动能上运行. 为了最大限度地提高部署效率,FreeOcc引入了一种意识到不确定性的混合机制. 这条通向单一通道的解码器的防波索尔线,将ODE解码器专门留给模棱两可的高不确定性区域。 仅需要28.3M参数大致40%的可比较模型-我们的最佳组合模式(FreeOcc-E)运行于27 FPS. 在nuScenes上,FreeOcc以0.47米的近田Chamfer距离(NFCD)和32.1%的mIoU实现最先进的预测性能. 此外,该型号将零射入SemanticKITTI. 它还证明非常坚固,保留了92.8%的理想mIoU在重大传感器包丢失和时间戳热中。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Anticipating the future 3D structure of a driving scene is critical for pre-emptive motion planning. Dense 4D occupancy forecasting addresses this by predicting a sequence of future voxelised binary volumes { O τ } τ = 1 N \{O_{\tau}\}_{\tau=1}^{N} directly from recent sensor history, elegantly capturing complex scene geometry without relying on explicit object detection or tracking.

Recent works tackle this via: autoregressive token generation Zheng et al. (2024) ; Zhang et al. (2024) , continuous flow formulations Shi et al. (2024) , geometric proxy representations Yu et al. (2026) , and unsupervised implicit fields Agro et al. (2024) ; Yang et al. (2024) . However, these methods generally rely on cross-attention or deep recurrence to separate the ego-vehicle’s motion from observed scene dynamics. This entanglement inflates parameter counts. It also requires expensive temporal attention and complicates error control at long horizons. Crucially, the ego-vehicle’s future trajectory is typically available at inference time as the intended route provided by the motion planner. While explicit S ​ E ​ ( 2 ) SE(2) warping in BEV space is well established Jaderberg et al. (2015) , recent generative world models have largely favoured learned temporal attention instead. In this setting, learned alignment is unnecessary: a single geometric warp factors out ego-motion and leaves the model to focus on residual dynamics, occlusion evolution, and far-field extrapolation. Driven by this insight, we propose FreeOcc . By mathematically factoring out self-motion, our architecture simplifies the forecasting pipeline, yielding three primary contributions:

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Recent world models approach future scene prediction through autoregressive token generation Zheng et al. (2024) , discrete diffusion Zhang et al. (2024) , implicit fields Agro et al. (2024) , or camera-based point cloud forecasting Yang et al. (2024) . However, these paradigms typically dedicate massive capacity to entangling ego-motion and scene dynamics via deep recurrence or cross-attention. FreeOcc bypasses this bottleneck by explicitly factoring out self-motion via algebraic S ​ E ​ ( 2 ) SE(2) warping (see Section 3.4), allowing it to directly predict dense voxel grids via physics-constrained continuous flow matching (CFM) without relying on discrete tokenisation or implicit rendering.
blocks.zh: 近代世界模型通过自相递减的符号生成来接近未来场景预测 郑等 (2024年),离散扩散 张等 (2024年),隐含地 Agro等 (2024年),或相机点预报 杨等 (2024年). 然而,这些范式通常都投入大量能力,通过深刻的再现或交叉的注意来凝聚自我运动和场景动态。 FreeOcc绕过这个瓶颈,通过代数S E (2) SE (2) warping(参见第3.4节)明确考虑出自动机,使其可以通过物理学所约束的连续流相匹配(CFM)直接预测高密度的阴道网格,而无需依赖离散地标化或隐含渲染.

blocks.en: Continuous normalising flows trained via flow matching Lipman et al. (2023) offer a simulation-free generative objective. Recent works like Streaming Flow Shi et al. (2024) , and latent flow models Liu et al. (2025) adapt this to occupancy and LiDAR streams. Yet, they still rely on computationally heavy dense cross-attention for temporal alignment. FreeOcc preserves the continuous expressivity of flow matching but replaces the attention bottleneck with an explicit geometric warp, further regularising the generative trajectory with physics-informed constraints (velocity smoothness, mass conservation, ray-traced free-space).
blocks.zh: 通过与Lipman等人(2023年)相匹配的流经训练的持续正常化流动提供了一个无基因模拟的目标。 近期作品有"流出流史"等(2024),"潜入流出"模型"刘等. (2025年)根据占用和LiDAR流来修改. 然而,它们仍然依赖于计算时空对接的密集的相互注意。 FreeOcc保留了流相匹配的连续表达性,但将注意力瓶颈取而代之的是明显的几何曲面,以物理学知情的限制(速度平滑,质量保护,射线跟踪自由空间)来进一步规范基因轨迹.

blocks.en: While integrating physical priors into perception is well-established—such as range-aware encoding Lang et al. (2019) or heteroscedastic uncertainty Kendall and Gal (2017) —applying structural constraints to dense 4D forecasting remains challenging. Recent concurrent works like SuperOcc Yu et al. (2026) and DTT Xu et al. (2025) enforce geometric structure by restricting the output space to predefined proxies (e.g., superquadrics or delta residuals), which inevitably sacrifices fine-grained fidelity on irregular shapes. Rather than simplifying the output representation, FreeOcc guides the full-resolution generative trajectory at the loss level. This ensures physically plausible dynamics while retaining exact voxel-level structural fidelity.
blocks.zh: 虽然将物理前科纳入知觉是既定的——例如测距-认识编码Lang等人(2019年)或异形不确定性Kendall和Gal(2017年)——但对密集的4D预测适用结构限制仍然是有挑战性的。 最近并行的作品有SuperOcc Yu等 (2026)和DTT Xu等. (2025年)执行几何结构,将输出空间限制在预定义的代词上(如超等分词或三角洲残基),这不可避免地会牺牲被精致地忠于不规则形状. FreeOcc没有简化产出表示,而是在损失水平上引导全分辨率的基因轨迹. 这确保了物理上可行的动态,同时保留了确切的阴道层次的结构忠诚。

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: FreeOcc forecasts dense 4D occupancy from LiDAR with an explicit task division: geometry handles ego-motion, while learning handles residual scene dynamics. By mathematically isolating the vehicle’s known trajectory via differentiable SE ⁡ ( 2 ) \mathrm{SE}(2) warping, we remove the need for learned temporal alignment, allowing the generative model to focus entirely on independently moving agents, occlusion evolution, and long-horizon uncertainty.
blocks.zh: FreeOcc从LiDAR中预测密集的4D占用,并有明确的任务分工:几何处理自负-运动,而学习处理剩余场景动态. 在数学上通过不同的SE(2)\mathrm{SE}(2) warping将车辆已知的轨迹隔离开来,我们消除了学习时间对接的需要,使得基因模型可以完全专注于独立移动的物剂,隔离进化,以及长期不确定性。

blocks.en: 3.3 Continuous-Time Temporal Aggregator
blocks.zh: 3.3 连续时间综合器

blocks.en: After encoding the individual sweeps into spatial features F i F_{i} , the model must aggregate them over time. Real-world LiDAR data suffers from scheduling jitter, delays and packet loss. Instead of learning temporal alignment with attention, FreeOcc encodes each sweep at its measured arrival time and lets a lightweight ConvGRU absorb the irregular history.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduce FreeOcc, a continuous-time world model for 4D occupancy forecasting. By explicitly decoupling ego-motion via SE(2) warping, we isolate residual scene dynamics. This formulation enables attention-free temporal fusion and physics-constrained continuous flow matching. To reduce inference latency, an uncertainty-aware routing mechanism processes well-observed geometry with a single-pass decoder, reserving ODE integration strictly for ambiguous regions. Operating with roughly 40% of the parameters of comparable models, FreeOcc achieves 32.1% mIoU on nuScenes at 27 FPS. Furthermore, the model demonstrates zero-shot transfer to SemanticKITTI and retains 92.8% of its mIoU under simulated sensor degradation. These results indicate that explicit geometric decoupling and physical priors provide an effective, robust foundation for autonomous driving perception.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了FreeOcc,4D入住预测的连续时间世界模型. 通过SE(2)分解自我运动,我们隔离了剩余场景动态。 这种配体可以使无注意力时间聚变和物理所约束的相接连续相接. 为了减少推论延迟性,一种不确定性意识的通向机制用单行道解码器处理观测良好的几何,严格地将ODE集成保留在模棱两可的区域. FreeOcc使用大约40%的可比较模型参数,在27 FPS的nuScens上实现32.1% mIoU. 此外,该模型还展示了向SemanticKITTI的零射入,并在模拟传感器降解时保留了92.8%的MIOU. 这些结果表明,明确的几何脱钩和物理前科为自主驱动感知提供了有效而坚实的基础.

blocks.zh: 附录B 限制和未来方向

blocks.en:
FreeOcc does not model semantic classes; extending the framework to class-conditional flow matching remains future work.
The ODE branch still adds non-trivial inference cost, which motivates future work on adaptive solvers or distillation.

FreeOcc不建模语义类;将框架扩展为类条件流匹配仍然是未来的工作.

blocks.en: Furthermore, the explicit geometric decoupling relies on a planar SE(2) ego-motion warp. This assumes flat-world dynamics, which may introduce minor spatial misalignments under severe pitch, roll, or steep inclines. However, enforcing SE(2) decoupling rather than a full 3D volumetric SE(3) warp drastically reduces the computational overhead of grid sampling. In practice, our evaluations demonstrate that the residual ConvGRU effectively absorbs minor Z-axis translations and pitch deviations, confirming that SE(2) alignment strikes the optimal balance between geometric accuracy and real-time inference latency for urban driving scenarios. Furthermore, the model treats the motion planner’s trajectory as a known input; however, experiments show that a self-predicted trajectory extrapolated from the vehicle’s recent speed and yaw rate, using no future information, still achieves 31.2% mIoU (vs. 32.1% with the recorded route), indicating that the method does not critically depend on an accurate external plan. Sensitivity to trajectory noise is analysed in Appendix I . Mitigating vulnerability to local odometry or planning drift remains an area for future refinement.
blocks.zh: 此外,明确的几何分解依赖于一个平面SE(2)自负-运动曲面。 这就假设了平地-世界动态,这可能会在严重的投出地,滚地或陡峭的地平线下引入细小的空间错位. 然而,执行SE(2)脱钩而不是完全的3D体积SE(3)曲速,大大减少了电网取样的计算间接费用。 在实践中,我们的评价表明,ConvGRU的剩余部分有效吸收了小的Z轴翻译和投出偏差,证实SE(2)对接在几何精度和城市行驶情景的实时推断延迟之间达成了最佳平衡. 此外,该模型将运动计程器的轨迹视为一种已知的输入;然而,实验显示,从车辆最近的速度和yaw率中推导出来的自预计轨迹,没有未来信息,仍能达到31.2% mIoU(与所记录的路线相比为32.1%),表明该方法并不严重依赖于准确的外部计划。 附录一分析了对轨迹噪声的敏感性。 减轻易受当地斜面测量或规划漂移影响的程度仍然是今后需要改进的领域。

blocks.en: C.3 Discussion: Sensor-Grounded vs. Completion-Based Evaluation
blocks.zh: C.3 讨论:传感器组合与基于完成的评价

blocks.en: We do not evaluate on Occ3D Tian et al. [2023] because it measures a different task. Occ3D targets occupancy completion : reconstructing the full 3D scene, including regions never observed by LiDAR, such as building interiors and heavily occluded surfaces. FreeOcc instead addresses sensor-grounded occupancy forecasting : predicting the 3D structure that the sensor will observe at future timesteps.
blocks.zh: 我们不评估Occ3D Tian等人。 [2023] 因为它衡量的任务不同. Occ3D目标入住完成:重建完整的3D场景,包括LiDAR从未观察到的区域,如建筑内部和被严重占用的地表. FreeOcc转而处理传感器定位占用预测 :预测传感器在未来时间步将观察到的三维结构.

blocks.en: This distinction matters for planning. The relevant target is future sensor-observable geometry, not the interior of occluded structures. Accordingly, our supervision is derived from future LiDAR returns rather than dense completion labels. Training against completion labels would force the model to infer geometry behind walls and inside objects, which is underdetermined and unnecessary for the forecasting setting considered here.
blocks.zh: 这种区别对规划很重要。 相关目标为未来能感知到可观测几何,而非被渗透结构的内部. 因此,我们的监督来自未来的LiDAR返回,而不是密集的完成标签。 使用完成标记的培训将迫使模型推断出墙后和物体内部的几何特征,这对于本文所考虑的预测环境来说是不够确定的和不必要的。

blocks.en: The evaluation objectives also differ. Occ3D rewards filling unobserved regions, whereas our protocol measures binary occupied/free IoU against future scans and therefore rewards accurate prediction of observable structure. These objectives need not align: a model tuned for completion may hallucinate geometry that improves completion scores but is undesirable for downstream planning.
blocks.zh: 评价目标也各不相同。 Occ3D 奖励填补未观测区域,而我们的协议措施是二进制/自由IoU 相对于未来的扫描,从而奖励对可观测结构的准确预测。 这些目标不需要一致:一个以完成为主的模型可能会产生几何的幻觉,改善完成分数,但对下游规划来说是不可取的。

blocks.en: The ablations in Table 6 support our core design philosophy. Removing Ego-Motion Warping causes the single largest drop (32.1 → \to 25.8 mIoU), confirming that explicit geometric decoupling is fundamental to forecasting accuracy. Within our loss system, the Structural Fidelity group is essential for grounding the discriminative path, while the Physical Priors (specifically velocity smoothness ℒ vel \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{vel}} ) ensure that the generative ODE produces kinematically plausible trajectories. Notably, removing either entire regularization group leads to a performance drop significantly larger than removing any individual term, proving that our physics-aware objectives act as a cohesive system rather than a collection of independent penalties.

blocks.en:
Figure 9 shows BEV projections of predicted occupancy coloured by s ^ v \hat{s}_{v} for scene-0220 across all six prediction horizons.
Three trends are consistent across the sequence: • Near-field confidence. At τ = 1 \tau{=}1 (0.5 s), uncertainty is concentrated on dynamic objects and occupancy boundaries, while large static structures remain comparatively confident. • Horizon-dependent growth. As τ \tau increases from 1 to 6 (0.5 s to 3.0 s), high-uncertainty regions expand and intensify. By τ = 4 \tau{=}4 , a turning vehicle near the centre of scene-0220 dominates the uncertainty map, reflecting the increasing ambiguity of its future trajectory. • Far-field diffusion. Sparse peripheral voxels become uncertain earlier than dense near-field regions, consistent with the weaker LiDAR support available at long range. These patterns are consistent with the ensemble rule in Section 3.7 : short-horizon predictions rely primarily on the decoder, whereas long-horizon and dynamic regions receive greater weight from the ODE branch.

blocks.en: Appendix H Latency Under Adverse Conditions
blocks.zh: 附录H 不利条件下的偶然性

blocks.en: A practical question is whether latency remains stable on visually and geometrically difficult scenes, such as rain, reflections, and dense intersections. Here we evaluate runtime directly on a challenging nuScenes rain sequence and report the observed spread.
blocks.zh: 一个实际的问题是,在视觉和几何困难的场景上,如雨、反射和密集相交点上,是否仍然保持耐久性。 在这里,我们直接评估一个具有挑战性的nuScens雨序列的运行时间,并报告观测到的传播.

blocks.en: Figure 16 shows a representative keyframe from nuScenes scene-0441 (rain, cross-intersection, lane change), one of the most demanding sequences in the dataset. We measure per-frame latency over all 40 keyframes and report the mean and worst-case runtime for FreeOcc-D and FreeOcc-E in Table 7 . OccWorld is included as an ideal-condition reference from our benchmark run.
blocks.zh: 图16显示了从nuScenes scene-0441(rain,横截面,车道变化)产生的代表性键框,这是数据集中要求最高的序列之一. 我们测量所有40个关键框架的每个框架间隔,并在表7中报告FreeOcc-D和FreeOcc-E的平均和最坏的运行时间。 OccWorld 是我们基准运行中最理想的参考文献

blocks.en: FreeOcc-E maintains a mean latency of 37.3 ms (26.8 FPS), with worst-case latency both at 39.1 ms. This spread is small and remains within roughly 2 ms of the dry-weather average reported in the main paper. FreeOcc-D is similarly stable at 22.1 ms (45.2 FPS). Even in this adverse sequence, FreeOcc-E remains faster than our OccWorld reference measured under ideal conditions (56 ms, 17.8 FPS).
blocks.zh: FreeOcc-E保持37.3 ms(26.8 FPS)的中位纬度,最坏情况为39.1 ms. 这种传播幅度很小,仍保持在主要文件所报干天气平均值的大约2米以内。 FreeOcc-D同样稳定在22.1 ms(45.2 FPS). 即使在这种不利的序列中,FreeOcc-E仍然比我们在理想条件下测量的OccWorld参考(56ms,17.8 FPS)更快.

blocks.en: These results suggest that, in our implementation, adverse weather and dense traffic do not materially bottleneck runtime. In FreeOcc-E, the fast discriminative decoder first processes the scene and generates the uncertainty map, which then selectively routes only the highly ambiguous regions to the continuous ODE solver. The stability shown in Table 7 indicates that even in challenging conditions like rain, the decoder remains confident enough to resolve the vast majority of the environment (e.g., road layout and free space). Consequently, the additional computational overhead from routing more voxels to the ODE solver is tightly bounded, resulting in a worst-case latency penalty of only about 2 ms. We report these empirical statistics to demonstrate that our uncertainty-aware routing is robust and avoids unbounded computational spikes in unpredictable environments.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,在我们的执行工作中,不利的天气和密集的交通不会在物质上阻碍运行时间。 在FreeOcc-E中,快分解解解码器首先处理场景并生成不确定性图,然后有选择地只将高度模糊的区域通向连续的ODE解码器. 表7显示的稳定性表明,即使在雨等有挑战性的条件下,解码器仍然有足够的信心来解决绝大多数环境(如道路布局和空地等). 因此,从向ODE 解析器输送更多活塞物的额外计算间接费用有严格的界限,导致最坏的延迟处罚只有2毫秒左右。 我们报告这些经验性统计数字是为了表明,我们认识到不确定性的路径是稳健的,避免在不可预测的环境中出现无约束的计算高峰。

blocks.en: Appendix I Trajectory Robustness Analysis
blocks.zh: 附录一 轨迹强度分析

blocks.en: To verify that FreeOcc’s advantage does not arise from privileged access to the exact future route, we conduct two analyses.
blocks.zh: 为了证实FreeOcc的优势并非来自特权进入确切的未来路线,我们进行了两次分析。

blocks.en: We inject Gaussian noise into the future ego-poses, reporting the accumulated L2 position error at 3 s.
blocks.zh: 我们把高斯语的噪音注入未来的自负层, 报告累积的L2位置误差 3 s.

blocks.en: Table 8: FreeOcc-E mIoU under injected future-trajectory error on nuScenes.
blocks.zh: 表8:在nuScenes上被注射出未来-弹出误差的FreeOcc-E mIoU.

blocks.en: FreeOcc-E degrades gracefully. Across the typical planner-error range ( < < 2 m at 3 s), it stays at 30.2 mIoU or above, well above OccWorld’s 28.9.
blocks.zh: FreeOcc-E 优雅地贬低了自己. 纵观典型的规划-误差范围( < 2 m at 3 s),它停留在30.2 mIoU或以上,远高于OccWorld的28.9.

blocks.en: We replace the recorded route with a constant-velocity / constant-yaw-rate extrapolation from the recent history, using no future information.
blocks.zh: 我们用近代史上的恒-速度/恒-延-速率推算来取代所记录的路线,不用未来的信息.

blocks.en: Table 9: FreeOcc-E with a self-predicted trajectory (no future information).
blocks.zh: 表9:具有自预计轨迹(无未来信息)的FreeOcc-E.

blocks.en: Even without access to the future route, FreeOcc-E reaches 31.2 mIoU, still above OccWorld.

blocks.en: Appendix J Information-Matched Warp Baselines
blocks.zh: 附录J 扭曲基线

blocks.en: To bound the contribution of the trajectory warp, we build two baselines on FreeOcc’s own temporally aggregated present state (not on OccWorld). Warp+Fuse warps this state to the future ego frame and refines it with a light fusion head. Warp+Fuse+FOV additionally masks the warped result to the future sensor field of view. Neither uses the flow-matching branch or the uncertainty ensemble.
blocks.zh: 为了限制轨迹曲速的贡献,我们在FreeOcc自身时间上汇总的目前状态(而不是OccWorld)上建立了两个基线。 扭曲+ 将这个状态扭曲到未来的自我框架,并用光聚变头来完善. Warp+Fuse+FOV 额外将被扭曲的结果遮住到未来的传感器视野. 既不使用流相配分枝,也不使用不确定性组合.

blocks.en: Appendix L Comparison with SparseWorld-TC
blocks.zh: 附录L 与 SparseWorld-TC 的比较

blocks.en: SparseWorld-TC Du et al. [2026] is a camera-based method designed for Occ3D semantic completion. We run the released model and evaluate it at the { 1 , 2 , 3 } \{1,2,3\} s horizons common to both methods, using our sensor-grounded metrics. We also include FreeOcc-Cam, a camera variant using a Lift-Splat-Shoot (LSS) encoder Philion and Fidler [2020] with our forecasting modules unchanged.

blocks.en: Appendix M Camera Modality Ablation
blocks.zh: 附录 M 相机 模式

blocks.en: To disentangle the LiDAR modality from the forecasting modules, we build FreeOcc-Cam by swapping only the LiDAR encoder for an LSS Philion and Fidler [2020] image-to-BEV encoder. All other components are unchanged. As a control, the camera baseline shares the same LSS encoder but replaces our forecasting stack with a plain feed-forward occupancy head (no ego-motion warp, temporal aggregation, flow matching, or ensemble). Both are trained on the same data.
blocks.zh: 为了将LiDAR模式从预测模块中分离出来,我们通过只将LiDAR编码器换为LSS Philion和Fidler[2020]图像到BEV编码器来构建FreeOcc-Cam. 所有其他组件不变。 作为控件,相机基线共享相同的LSS编码器,但用一个平坦的进取式占用头来取代我们的预测堆栈(没有自负-运动曲面,时间聚合,流量匹配,或综艺). 两者都接受同样的数据培训。
